Productivity_Trend_Script: SELECT log_date,productivity FROM daily_logs ORDER BY log_date
learning_tracker_category_count_Script: SELECT category,COUNT(*) total FROM learning_tracker GROUP BY category
Learning_table_Script: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS learning_tracker ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, learning_date TEXT,category TEXT,learning TEXT);
Table_View_Script: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'
View_History_Script: SELECT * FROM daily_logs ORDER BY id DESC
Daily_Logs_Table_Script: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS daily_logs(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,log_date TEXT,accomplishments TEXT,learnings TEXT,blockers TEXT,tomorrow_plan TEXT,productivity INTEGER)
Certification_table_Script: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS certifications(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, Certification_name TEXT, progress TEXT, target_date TEXT, status TEXT)
